changes: Verified the direct fail-closed regression for five-stage installation inventory exceptions added on main.
Verified the installation inventory is mandatory in the aggregate offline gate.
Bound descendant-process assertions to Linux process starttime so PID reuse cannot produce a false survivor failure.
Expanded only test-harness scheduling deadlines for FIFO and workflow simulations; production timeout and fail-closed behavior are unchanged.
failed_attempts: The first exact-head aggregate run hit two host-load timeouts: FIFO snapshot (2 seconds) and K1 workflow simulation (10 seconds); both passed immediately in isolation.
A second aggregate run exposed a PID-reuse-sensitive descendant assertion just beyond its one-second polling deadline.
A first deadline-only adjustment still failed because it did not disambiguate PID reuse; the final starttime-bound assertion passed three consecutive executions and the aggregate suite.
remaining_blockers: Real same-input evidence for 92 legacy/replacement workflow pairs with independent executions and artifact origins is absent.
Live/device and independent external restore evidence remains outside this offline verification.
